name: Legend TV
description: High-scale streaming platform for localized international content, reaching #1 in its category.
full_description:
# Legend TV — Viral Streaming Ecosystem

A cross-platform video streaming application serving the South Asian market with localized Turkish drama series.

## The Problem
Demand for localized international content was massive, but existing solutions were fragmented, slow, and lacked a unified high-quality mobile experience.

## What Was Built
- **Custom Streaming Engine**: Built with Flutter and optimized for low-bandwidth environments.
- **Scalable Infrastructure**: Architected a Firebase-backed system handling concurrent spikes during peak drama release hours.
- **Monetization Engine**: Integrated AppLovin Max and subscription tiers, generating $20k+ in revenue.
- **Localized Content Matrix**: Managed data flow for multiple languages and subtitle synchronization.

## Results
| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| Active Users | 600,000+ |
| App Store Rank | #1 (5 months) |
| Revenue | $20,000+ |
| User Rating | 4.7 ★ |
bullets: Scaled to 600,000+ users organically through product-market fit
Maintained #1 category ranking for 5 consecutive months
Architected high-concurrency Firebase backend for video metadata
Delivered premium streaming UX on low-end Android devices
Engineered complete ad-tech stack integration with AppLovin Max

name: Firebase Core Infrastructure
description: Critical open-source packages for Flutter, simplifying Firebase Messaging and Admin SDK.
full_description:
# Firebase Flutter Open Source Packages

Author of high-impact plugins that simplify the integration of Firebase Cloud Messaging and Admin SDK functions directly within Dart.

## The Problem
Flutter developers frequently faced massive boilerplate and platform-specific complexities when implementing the Firebase Admin SDK or advanced FCM behaviors.

## What Was Built
- **firebase_admin_sdk**: A pure Dart port/wrapper enabling admin-level tasks (user mgmt, custom claims) from high-privilege environments.
- **firebase_cloud_messaging_flutter**: Enhanced notification handling with local triggers and simplified payload management.
- **Developer Experience**: Documentation and implementation guides for the global community.

## Impact
Reduced integration time for complex notification systems by estimated 60% for adopters. Showcased deep understanding of Firebase internals and package architecture.
bullets: Published 'firebase_admin_sdk' for server-side Dart task management
Published 'firebase_cloud_messaging_flutter' for advanced notifications
Simplified hundreds of lines of boilerplate into reusable Dart logic
Assisted global developers in integrating strict admin-level Firebase controls
Bridging the gap between Flutter frontend and Firebase Backend logic

name: LifeLink
description: AI-powered wellness and suicide prevention app using Gemini Pro for immediate support.
full_description:
# LifeLink — Wellness Crisis Infrastructure

A critical mental health application providing zero-friction access to emergency resources and AI-powered mood support.

## The Problem
In high-stress situations, users need immediate, reliable tools without complex navigation or slow load times.

## What Was Built
- **AI Support Matrix**: Integrated Google Gemini Pro for mood tracking and conversational support.
- **Emergency Geo-Logic**: Real-time localization of nearest support centers.
- **Wellness Tracker**: Seamless tracking of sleep, diet, and stress using local caching (Hive/iSar).
- **Isolate-Based Monitoring**: High-performance background tasks for wellness notifications.

## Impact
Directly serving as a digital safety net for vulnerable users, combining advanced AI with robust offline-first architecture.
bullets: Integrated Gemini AI for real-time mood analysis and user support
Engineered offline-first architecture for critical crisis data retrieval
Localized nearest emergency centers via high-precision geolocation
Implemented smooth, low-friction UX focusing on crisis management
Utilized Flutter Isolates for non-blocking wellness metrics calculation

name: ICare Meditation
description: Deep-wellness platform with biometrics, mood tracking, and voice-guided sessions.
full_description:
# ICare — Holistic Wellness Platform

A comprehensive meditation app leveraging biometrics and secure community logic for a unified mental health experience.

## The Problem
Meditation apps often lack strong privacy (for journals) or social accountability. ICare bridges specialized tracking with a secure community.

## What Was Built
- **Biometric Security**: Integrated Fingerprint Auth for secure personal journals/diaries.
- **Guided Session Engine**: Custom voice-over playback architecture with background music mixing.
- **Cloud Integration**: Node.js Cloud Functions for community feed and leaderboard management.
- **State Control**: Utilized GetX and Isolates for heavy media processing tasks.

## Impact
Created a high-privacy, feature-rich wellness ecosystem that encourages long-term user retention through social and biometric integration.
bullets: Secured user data using biometric (Fingerprint) authentication barriers
Engineered audio mixing engine for guided meditation sessions
Mapped complex social interactions using Firebase Cloud Functions
Designed a 'catchy' UI prioritizing psychological calm and focus
Implemented mood visualization charts using synchronized local data
